instruction.text: Why is information important? Select the three correct answers.

feedback.end: Information is important for expanding and developing your knowledge. Without information, it would be impossible for society to function.

instruction.text: Minnie would like to find out about ladybirds. Where could she find information on this topic? Drag the correct answers to the box below.
Select all of the objects that you could use to search specifically for information about ladybirds.

hint.label: Smartwatch
hint.text: A smartwatch is a watch with extra functions. On many smartwatches, you can access the internet or read a newspaper.

feedback.end: The most useful source of information is the internet, which you can access through many devices.
